Hi all — quick legal take so you have a consistent response for Brightlane this afternoon.

1) Coverage minimums: those limits (CGL 1M/2M, umbrella 5M, E&O 1M) are standard and acceptable. Confirm carrier and policy period on the COI; we need primary, non-contributory language if Brightlane requires it for waiver/indemnity purposes.

2) Additional Insured (AI): for SaaS contracts we do not generally provide a broad AI endorsement that expands coverage beyond liability arising from our performance of the services. We can agree to a "limited" AI endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) naming Brightlane as additional insured with respect to liability arising out of Redwood's operations/services under the order form, subject to the following:
   - AI limited to the services in the order form (no blanket AI).
   - Endorsement that does not broaden coverage or materially increase premiums.
   - Carrier confirmation required (broker to provide endorsement form).

3) Retroactive date (E&O): if Brightlane requires a prior-acts/retroactive date we will try to accommodate, but this is a function of our Professional Liability policy (carrier). We must confirm that the retroactive date does not pre-date our policy inception in a way that would create gaps. If the broker cannot provide the requested retroactive date, alternative is to accept contractual indemnity language limited to claims arising from our covered services.

4) Temporary COI for signature: Legal can accept a temporary COI for up to 30 days provided the broker confirms endorsement will be delivered within that timeframe and the COI states the coverage types and limits. We should document the exception in the order form ("COI accepted as interim proof; endorsement to be delivered within 30 days or contractually subject to cure/termination").

Action items for Procurement response (Priyom / Kimberly):
- Ask broker to provide the temporary COI now and an ETA for the AI endorsement.
- Require Evergreen to confirm in writing the endorsement form and delivery date (within 30 days).
- If endorsement cannot be obtained, escalate to Legal for alternative risk-transfer language (indemnity expansion or additional controls).

I'll prepare a short clause you can paste into the order form acceptance paragraph if Evergreen provides the temporary COI.

— Aditya
